findings.finding: the strategy adapter can accept alternate self-consistent window shapes
mixed primary/replacement shapes can be adapter-valid in general
prepareReplacementAppend is not sufficient governance authority
at ledger size 10 the adapter cannot enforce the canonical success count, because its P6 arm (entryCount > 10) is false at any success count, so a forged success count passes that layer
the replacement planner does not independently enforce global Q1 order
the adapter can accept a SPENT committed strategy replayed against an unchanged ledger and regenerate already-adjudicated items, because acquisition success is not encoded in the ledger
findings.mitigation: every new child strategy requires BOTH an exact fresh committed-state binding AND an independently adjudication-derived next untouched primary; a strategy proposing P41-P45 must be refused even if the adapter accepts it
